race.description: Von Robertson Wtc Thanks You For 10 Yrs Hcp (Bm60)
race.comment: The well-related RUNAROUND SUE (1) (half to G3 winner Thiamandi) has been in the money at both starts this time in work, the latest a second over 800m at Ipswich. Has a solid record at the third run in so she looks the testing material against this line-up. I AM GONE (10) won narrowly by 0.6 lengths two runs back at Gatton then missed the frame last time at Ipswich. Gets a little weight relief. Has been in sound form this prep with two wins from five starts and is sure to run well. SUTHERLAND (3) didn't do a bad job when sixth last start over 800m at Ipswich, beaten only 2 lengths. That followed a win at this circuit the start prior. Yet to miss the frame in four starts over this course and distance and has the class to return to the winner's list. TARA'S REWARD (6) ran a better race when second-up last start, finishing 1.1 lengths away in fourth over 800m at Ipswich. Finds a nice race and can make amends.
